name: @hxmc/gfx
description: A portable GPU layer for hxmc, in pure Haxe: integer handles, immutable pipelines, back ends over the system's GPU APIs (GL through EGL, Metal, Direct3D 11, WebGPU, and GL on WebGL2 in browsers without WebGPU) and a shader macro (Haxe functions to GLSL, WGSL, MSL and HLSL)
